inj.note: James missed the Chargers' three games prior to the Week 7 bye due to a hamstring injury. He suffered a setback in his recovery during Week 8 prep, which will require a stint on IR for the veteran safety. James is required to be sidelined for at least four games, so the earliest he can return is Week 12 against the Patriots on Sunday, Nov. 29. Tony Jefferson will continue to operate in an elevated role in the secondary in James' absence.

news.h: Derwin James placed on injured reserve after hamstring rehab setback
news.d: The Chargers have placed safety Derwin James Jr. on injured reserve because of a hamstring injury.

news.h: How Chargers 2026 first-round pick Akheem Mesidor is faring so far
news.d: Safety Derwin James Jr. says Mesidor will be one of the top edge rushers in the league. Judging by the rookie's performance so far, that prediction may not be far off the mark.
